query: SELECT action.id, tool_execution.inference_id AS request_inference_id, tool_execution.ordinal AS request_ordinal, inference.output AS request_output, approving.inference_id AS approval_inference_id, action.result_content_id FROM action LEFT JOIN tool_execution ON tool_execution.id = action.requesting_tool_execution_id LEFT JOIN inference ON inference.id = tool_execution.inference_id LEFT JOIN tool_execution AS approving ON approving.id = action.approving_tool_execution_id WHERE tool_execution.inference_id = ? ORDER BY action.id
